text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Haa! Haa! Haa...!!
(UWAAAAAAAHHH--!!!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh...? These cheers...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! Ticket-zo won!!
Yes, yes, YESSS--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*, *sniffle*!!
That was the greatest race ever, Ticket-zo!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ti-cket-zo!
Ti-cket-zo!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"...My name...
They're chanting for me..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I won...? M-Me...!?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ti-cket-zo!
Ti-cket-zo!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoa, waaaahhh...!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAH!!
I did it, I did it, I DID IIIT!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I did ittttttt~~!!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on conquering the Japan Derby!
I couldn't take my eyes off the fierce clash between the BNW!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe!
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The view after crossing the finish line was the absolute best!! Everyone in the stands had sparkling eyes...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hearing everyone chant 'Ticket-zo!' made my heart flutter so much,
it reaaally felt like a dream...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy I could run a race in the Derby I dreamed of
that gives everyone else dreams too!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: Will your next challenge be the Kikuka Sho after all?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I just finished running the Derby, so
I haven't really thought about what's next yet, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's the Kikuka Sho or anything else,
I'll deliver an intense race just like today's!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: Could we get a final word from you, please!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sir!!!!!
Um, uhhh...!!
Winning Ticket flashed a beaming smile toward the camera.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I am the Umamusume who conquered this Derby,
Winning Ticket!!!!
(WAAAAAAAAH---!!!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Trainer-saaaaaaaan!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
THANK YOOOOOU!!
To dink dat *I* could win de Derbaaaay~~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear that too, Trainer?!
That massive chant! Everyone cheering for us!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It was just like the Derby I watched that day!
...No, the excitement was even greater!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I was able to run a race in the Derby
that truly moved everyone!

Her long-sought dream of conquering the Derby—
had come true in the most glorious fashion imaginable.
choice_data_list: That was the best race ever!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
UWOOOOOOH~~!! Hearing you say that too,
Trainer, I'm so moveeeed~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...And of course she's crying.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishin...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Just so you know,
I'll get mad if you pity me."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You were definitely strong today.
I can tell you gave it your absolute best race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Still, it's not over yet.
My real race starts here.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin's running was amazing too!!
It got me all fired up!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: So... let's run together again!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Naturally. Because I'm winning next time...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I dreamed of the Japanese Derby, too.
I had no intention of holding back.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "...A complete defeat, huh. But next time, I won't yield. Never."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations, Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
U-Uwaaaaaaaan!!
It's all thanks to the two of youuuuu~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
THANK YOU GUUUUYYYS!!
TAISHIN, HAYAHIDEEEEEE!!
Winning Ticket's emotional shouts and the audience's lingering cheers showed no sign of stopping anytime soon.
